Synopsis:
Non-critpath. A human adventurer accuses a tiefling child of stealing a necklace from him. A tiefling guard may intervene if things get out of hand. 

Barth: Angry, but gruff and restrained. 
Meli: Fearless, urging Barth on.

Cluster Contexts:
- DEN_Thieflings_RobbedAdventurer.json: The scene takes place in or near the Den hideout where a human adventurer (Barth) angrily accuses a tiefling child (Meli) of stealing his locket; Meli is defiant and mocking while Barth threatens violence. Off‑screen the player has already had run‑ins with Mol and her crew of tiefling kids—sometimes friendly, sometimes thieving—which explains why both sides expect theft, bargaining, or threats. Mol is a precocious teen crime boss who fiercely protects her gang, so her prior dealings with the player will shape whether the kids hand the item over, lie, or escalate. If things heat up, a tiefling guard or other Den members may step in; the player’s companions and earlier choices determine whether the outcome is a fight, a bargain, or an explanation that the necklace was lost.
- DEN_Thieflings_AdventurerRobber_Solo.json: This exchange is with a young tiefling from the Den’s pickpocket crew (one of Mol’s kids) who was involved in stealing the player’s necklace/amulet. Off‑screen the player may already have met Mol or her gang — having fought, parleyed, struck bargains, or been scammed by their coin‑flip tricks — and those prior choices shape whether the child is defiant, nervous, grateful, or willing to hand the trinket back. Depending on earlier actions the kid might still be hiding the necklace, have already returned it, or claim never to have had it; lines range from cheeky taunts and childish complaints to reluctant thanks or bargaining. Companions can be nearby and influence the tone, and Mol’s protective leadership often explains why the kids act as a coordinated crew rather than lone thieves.
- DEN_Thieflings_Adventurer_Solo.json: Non-critpath. Takes place after the player resolves the confronation between this adventurer and the thiefling boy who stole the adventurer's necklace.
- DEN_Thieflings_Pickpocket_002.json: Silfy is a very young (7–9) tiefling member of Mol’s Den crew — a nervy, fidgety kid assigned as a “guard” while her partner (often Mattis) runs a distraction/sales routine. Off-screen the player has already had dealings with Mol’s gang (friendly, hostile, or transactional), and Mol’s attitude and the kids’ willingness to return stolen goods will reflect those prior choices. Though Silfy is a gifted pickpocket, she’s painfully shy and bad at lying; here she’s surprised the player is speaking to her and is improvising excuses about not selling anything. The exchange can lead to a partial admission that she’s taken something, but Mol’s presence or past bargains may influence whether items are recovered.
- GOB_Festivities_GoblinKid002_LootingCrime.json: An unpleasant goblin kid's crime reaction on looting dead adventurer's body.
